summary: Iteration 2 verifies the new abuse-protection layer. All 29 pytest tests pass: 17 regression (test_safe_sorry.py, passwords bumped to 10 chars) + 12 new rate-limit tests in test_abuse_limits.py. Verified: 8/9-char register -> 422; 10-char ok; legacy tom@example.com/test1234 login still 200; JWT exp-iat == 7 days; 6th failed login per email -> 429 with Retry-After, and correct password blocked while locked; 11th failed login per IP (10 unique emails, same X-Forwarded-For) -> 429; 6th register per IP within hour -> 429; 6th POST /api/assessments per user/day -> 429 with 'limit of 5 family checks' detail; 4th POST /api/leads per user/day -> 429; AI-story quota verified safely by hitting tom's CACHED story 6x -> all 200 (quota only consumed on new generations, as per spec - avoided burning LLM credits). Frontend UI check on mobile viewport 390x844: register with 8-char password shows 'Please choose a password of at least 10 characters.' inside auth-error container; 10+ char password registers successfully and routes to /assessment. rate_limits collection cleared at start AND end of module so tom is never locked out.
critical_code_review_comments: limiter.take uses a two-phase upsert that cleanly handles the window-full race (DuplicateKeyError fallback) - good.

login endpoint uses limiter.check (non-consuming) before verifying creds, then limiter.record on failure - correct pattern that prevents correct-password-after-lockout bypass, confirmed in test_login_fail_per_email_locks_at_6th_attempt.
rate_limits TTL index via expireAfterSeconds=0 on expires_at - good self-cleanup.
DUMMY_HASH used for timing-equaliser on unknown email - good constant-time behaviour.
Still uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') - minor, consider lifespan context manager.
seed_data_creation: Created ~15 TEST_* / test_* users across the register-per-IP and brute-force tests. All on unique X-Forwarded-For IPs. rate_limits collection cleared at end so tom@example.com is not locked out.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rate-limit counters live in Mongo collection `rate_limits` keyed by namespace:key:window-start. Always use a unique X-Forwarded-For per test flow and unique emails. The module-scope fixture _clear_rate_limits in test_abuse_limits.py wipes the collection before and after. Namespaces in use: register-ip (5/hour), login-fail-ip (10/15min), login-fail-email (5/15min), assess-user (5/day), story-user (5/day), lead-user (3/day). Cached /story returns without consuming story-user quota - do NOT trigger more than ~1-2 fresh story generations in tests (LLM credits). Passwords must be >= 10 chars for /auth/register; tom's legacy 8-char password still works for /auth/login only.
